entities.name: Boc-protected piperazine thioamide
observations: SELFIES reactant decodes to a Boc-protected piperazine thioamide bearing an aryl-CF3 group.
An exact matching ORD reaction record identifies this as the substrate for TFA-mediated Boc deprotection in DCM.

entities.name: Piperazine thioamide
observations: Product is the deprotected piperazine thioamide with an N-H; thioamide and aryl-CF3 groups are retained.

entities.name: Trifluoroacetic acid
observations: Reported reagent for the exact matching Boc deprotection reaction.

entities.name: Dichloromethane
observations: Reported solvent for the exact matching Boc deprotection reaction.

entities.name: Boc deprotection
observations: TFA in DCM removes the tert-butoxycarbonyl substituent from the piperazine nitrogen, restoring N-H; returned evidence gives no time or temperature.
